name: Baby Hospital
summary:
Welcome to Baby Hospital, where tiny cries meet big hearts!
In this arcade idle VR experience, you’ll step into the shoes of a caring doctor running a bustling baby clinic. From curing common colds to calming fussy newborns, every patient brings a new story — and every successful treatment brings your hospital to life.

Hire helpers, upgrade your equipment, and expand your clinic to treat more adorable patients.
As your hospital grows, unlock new treatment rooms, playful decorations, and advanced baby care
